newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nichimen plans to form trading firm in China - paper.
newsitem.headline: Nichimen plans to form trading firm in China - paper.

text.p: Trading house Nichimen Corp has applied to the Chinese government for approval to establish a trading firm in China, which it aims to start operating in early 1997, a Japanese daily said on Friday.
The economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said Nichimen planned to form a joint trading company with a Chinese partner.
The new trading house would deal with food, industrial plants, machinery and electrical appliances and aim for annual sales of $5 billion, the paper said.
Nichimen officials were not immediately available for comment.
